body:
# Misty Ore

This mod adds several new ores for a fresh experience in the game.

This mod adds various new ores to the world of Minecraft, and you can also create different items, armor, and tools using these ores. You can craft various items, armor, and tools simply by looking at the recipe that appears if you have obtained an item related to the item you want to craft.

Some ores can be used to craft tools and armor.

Wait a few more weeks for the latest version update.

Currently, the mod is still in development to add many items and needs feedback from users to improve this mod.

So your feedback is very helpful for the development of this mod
